archetypes.name: bash-parity
archetypes.rationale: Diff ports a narrow bash pre-push conflict handoff path where token, flag, and branch parity are critical.
archetypes.prompt_body: Compare the Python rebase changes against the described bash exit-4 pre-push handoff semantics. Pay special attention to site-1 waterfall exhaustion versus site-2 remaining-conflicts behavior, non-bump-only gating, literal resume/caller tokens, and intentional Phase 7 deferrals. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: handoff-contract
archetypes.rationale: The new exception subtype is a future driver contract and should preserve library boundaries without leaking driver responsibilities.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review whether PrePushConflictHandoff is modeled at the right abstraction level for a library-only signal. Check exception inheritance, config-free error definitions, caller-supplied tokens, and whether rebase.py exposes enough information for future driver translation without prematurely adding driver state or exit-code behavior. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: bump-gate
archetypes.rationale: The handoff depends on subtle path classification for bump-only, mixed, and non-bump conflict sets.
archetypes.prompt_body: Examine the bump-file classification logic and its interaction with deterministic conflict prepass results. Look for mismatches in CHANGELOG/plugin/version/go.sum/LARCH_BUMP_FILES handling, path separator assumptions, exact path matching, empty conflict sets, and mixed conflict behavior. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
